summary: Completion providers may use any single trigger character, e.g. `#` for tickets, not only `@` and `/`. The new provider option `triggers` sets a char's label, pill prefix, default pick behavior and the mention types it owns; `createCompletionSearch` takes a `source` filter per call.
howTo: Set `trigger: '#'` on a `ChatCompletionProvider` to open its list with `#`; add `triggers={[{ char: '#', label, prefix, types: ['ticket'] }]}` (memoized) to AiChatProvider to change the defaults, and pass the same array as `createLocalSessionStore({ triggers })` so sent messages, history and session titles show `#` for those types instead of `@`. Nothing changes without it: `@` and `/` keep their behavior. `RichMentionInputProps.triggers` widened to `ReadonlyArray<string | ChatTriggerDefinition>` and validates its entries; `composer.inputProps` from `useChatComposerInput` now always carries `triggers`, so spread it before your own `triggers` prop if you set one.
